_meta.note: Pricing is in LKR. Suggested starting rates for the Sri Lankan market as of November 2026. These are our proposed prices, not copied competitor prices. Owner must approve all rates before publishing.

principles.en: You see one total price and exactly how it is built.
principles.si: ඔබට පෙනෙන්නේ එකම මුළු මිලක් සහ එය හැදෙන ආකාරයයි.

principles.en: No hidden monthly fees or surprise service charges.
principles.si: සැඟවුණු මාසික ගාස්තු හෝ අමතර service charges නැත.

principles.en: Hardware is priced at the vendor's real price -- you are connected to the vendor directly.
principles.si: Hardware මිල vendor ගේ සැබෑ මිලමයි -- vendor ව ඔබට කෙලින්ම සම්බන්ධ කරනු ලැබේ.

principles.en: After full payment the system is handed over completely to you.
principles.si: සම්පූර්ණ ගෙවීමෙන් පසු පද්ධතිය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම ඔබට භාරදෙනු ලැබේ.

bullets.si: ඔබේ ව්‍යාපාරයේ අවශ්‍යතාවලට ගැළපෙන ලෙස සකස් කරයි

bullets.en: Free user manual and basic remote training
bullets.si: නොමිලේ user manual සහ මූලික remote training
ඕනෑම තැනක සිට භාවිතා කළ හැක
දේශීයව offline, online වූ විට sync

priceBreakdownTemplate.description: Every quote shows these line items so the client sees how the total is formed.

benefits.si: Software එකට lifetime warranty (bug fixes නොමිලේ)

founderOffer.needsConfirmation: Owner said both 'lifetime warranty' (Q9) and '5-year free support, no lifetime support' (Q30). Confirm exact wording and what is included before activating this offer. Confirm how many of the 20 slots have already been claimed. Remove this offer after 20 clients.

discounts.note: No standing promotions. Case-by-case per client.

refund.en: No refunds. Only an overpayment made by mistake is refunded (the excess amount only).
refund.si: මුදල් ආපසු ගෙවීමක් නැත. වැරදීමකින් වැඩිපුර ගෙවූ මුදල පමණක් (වැඩිපුර ගෙවූ කොටස පමණක්) ආපසු ගෙවනු ලැබේ.

inputs.hardware: List from hardware.json, quantity per item, or 'I already have hardware'

calculator.formula: total = base(package, businessType) + (stations-1)*perExtraStation + branches*perExtraBranch + hostingFirstYear(if cloud/hybrid) + sum(hardware vendor prices) + dataEntryDays*dailyRate + installTraining(if requested) + transportKm*transportPerKm - discount

devSampleRates_NOT_REAL.note: ONLY for building/testing the UI. Never display on a live site.

disclaimer.en: This is an estimate. The final price is confirmed after we study your business.
disclaimer.si: මෙය ඇස්තමේන්තුවකි. ඔබේ ව්‍යාපාරය අධ්‍යයනය කළ පසු අවසාන මිල තහවුරු කරනු ලැබේ.

blockingItems.title: Pricing numbers
blockingItems.details: Approve base prices for Desktop, Cloud and Hybrid, extra station, extra branch, yearly hosting, data-entry rate, installation and training, and transport. Current values are proposed starting rates, not final approved prices.

blockingItems.title: Founder offer wording
blockingItems.details: Resolve the difference between 'Lifetime software warranty' (Q9) and '5-year free support, no lifetime support' (Q30). Confirm how many of the 20 slots have already been claimed.

blockingItems.title: Founders
blockingItems.details: Add the 4 founders' names, roles, photos and optional bios / LinkedIn links.

blockingItems.title: Hardware vendors
blockingItems.details: Add hardware vendor names, contact details and verified real prices. Confirm whether the company adds any margin. Hardware prices must not be invented.

blockingItems.title: Payment schedule
blockingItems.details: Confirm advance percentage, payment milestones or pay-after-completion terms. Bank details should only be shared after an order is confirmed.

blockingItems.title: Handover policy
blockingItems.details: Confirm whether full handover includes source code and repository access, or only the running system, database and client data.

blockingItems.title: Hosting provider
blockingItems.details: Verify commercial-use terms, limitations and suitability before choosing a hosting provider. Vercel Hobby may not be suitable for commercial use; evaluate Cloudflare Pages and other suitable hosting options.

blockingItems.title: Google Apps Script integration
blockingItems.details: Create and configure Google Apps Script, Google Sheet storage and email notifications for quote requests, order requests and custom requirements.

blockingItems.title: Package scope and feature limits
blockingItems.details: Define exactly what is included in each package, including users, cashier stations, branches, customisation limits, backups, updates and support. Avoid promising unlimited custom development under a fixed base price.

pricingNotes.status: Internal planning reference. Not a public competitor comparison.
notes: Desktop, Cloud and Hybrid prices are proposed starting prices for owner approval.
Yearly hosting is charged separately for Cloud and Hybrid packages.
Hardware is excluded from software package prices and must use verified vendor prices.
Transport is estimated using the entered distance. Confirm whether the calculator should use one-way or round-trip distance.
Business type adjustment is currently zero. Review after collecting real project data.
Custom requirements outside the agreed package scope need a separate quotation.
